idea-plugin.name: Panda Vivid Black & Modern Dark Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Four dark themes for JetBrains IDEs and Android Studio, each with an Islands variant:
  • Panda Vivid Black: pink keywords, teal types and strings, blue functions, and purple numbers.
  • Panda Modern Dark: near-black UI, orange keywords, blue types, purple functions, and green strings.
  • Panda Modern Cyan: cyan types, purple fields, and blue member method calls and named arguments.
  • Panda Flutter Dark: green keywords, orange types, cyan identifiers, pink strings, and #AFCEA2 numbers.
Includes language-specific styling for Dart/Flutter, Kotlin, Java, XML, and more. Fonts are configured separately; no special font is required.
